reason: The README describes a web GUI wallpaper plugin whose primary purpose is customizing backgrounds, translucency, layout, brightness, and playback settings with local and imported media.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可自定义的图片、GIF 和视频壁纸背景，并支持透明度、布局、亮度及播放速度设置。
summaries.en: Adds customizable image, GIF, and video wallpaper backgrounds to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with layout, brightness, and playback controls.

capabilities: customizes the web GUI background with local images, GIFs, and videos
changes selected interface background tokens and renders a click-through media overlay
stores selected media and preferences on the local machine
imports Wallpaper Engine media and can record supported wallpapers through ffmpeg on Windows
